thig13.2:1.1: supi → maṁ vipassi (sya-all) | sayasi → bhoti supi (bj: machasaṁ) | supi → bhoti tvaṁ sayasi (cck: sī.); bhoti maṁ vipassi (cck: syā.)
thig13.2:1.2: pabujjhasi samaṇāneva → paṭibujjhasi samaṇānameva (bj, sya-all) | paṭibujjhasi → pabujjhasi (bj: machasaṁ) | pabujjhasi → paṭibujjhasi (cck: sī. syā.)
thig13.2:1.3: samaṇānameva → samaṇāneva (bj: machasaṁ) | Samaṇāneva → samaṇānameva (cck: sī. syā.)
thig13.2:2.2: paveccasi rohinī dāni → payacchasi rohiṇīdāni (bj) | paveccasi rohinī → pavecchasi rohiṇi (sya-all) | payacchasi → pavecchasi (bj: machasaṁ) | paveccasi → payacchasi (cck: sī.)
thig13.2:8.3: sukkāna dhammānaṁ → sukkehi dhammehi (sya-all) | dhammānaṁ → sukkehi dhammehi (cck: sī. syā. aṭṭha.)
thig13.2:21.4: nhātako rohinī → nhātakoti itthaṁ sudaṁ rohiṇī (bj)
thig13.2:22.1: therī → therī gāthāyo abhāsīti rohiṇītherīgāthā (bj) | rohinī therī → rohiṇī (sya-all)
